description: Regur / black cotton soil. High clay content, self-mulching, retains moisture deep into the dry season.
Iron-oxide rich soil formed on crystalline rock. Porous, moderately fertile, responds well to fertilizer.
Formed under heavy monsoon leaching. Acidic and low in nitrogen, but excellent for tree and spice crops.
Coarse-grained, low water-holding capacity, typical of arid and semi-arid tracts.
River-deposited soil, replenished annually, the most fertile and widely cultivated soil in India.
Shallow, humus-rich soils on slopes, texture and depth varying sharply with elevation.
